title: Implement LIST ACTIVE, LIST NEWSGROUPS, NEWGROUPS, NEWNEWS
description:
Implement LIST ACTIVE: return one line per known group (group high low status). Implement LIST NEWSGROUPS: return group descriptions. Implement NEWGROUPS date time: return groups created after given timestamp. Implement NEWNEWS date time: return Message-IDs of articles newer than given timestamp across specified groups. Artifact: reader/src/session/commands/list.rs.

Acceptance:
- LIST ACTIVE output parseable by slrn, tin, and Thunderbird (tested)
- NEWGROUPS returns correct set for a known test timestamp
- NEWNEWS returns correct Message-IDs for a known time range
- NEWNEWS with wildmat pattern filters groups correctly
